target_reviews.assessment_reason: The L=50 panel itself is reproduced exactly, but the adjoining main-text quantitative claim that its edge profile has decay length 2 ln(3) is incompatible with the paper's own exact 3^{-b} formula. In physical-site units the exact length is 2/ln(3); block units and inverse-decay conventions do not recover the printed expression.

independent_checks.claim: Writing 3^{-b}=exp[-(2b)/(2/ln 3)] for j=2b-1,2b gives xi=2/ln(3)=1.8204784532536746 physical sites, whereas the printed 2 ln(3)=2.1972245773362196.

The exact successive-block magnitude ratio is 1/3. The printed length predicts exp[-2/(2 ln 3)]=0.4024279410, while 2/ln(3) predicts 1/3 exactly; direct MPS and closed-form profiles agree to 1.84e-15.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The main-text value 2 ln(3) is a valid decay length under a block-site, physical-site, or inverse-decay convention.
falsification_attempts.method: Evaluate the exact one-block ratio from the supplemental formula under all three conventions and compare it with the frozen L=50 profile and direct-MPS crosscheck.

discrepancy.paper_claim: The exact OBC edge-energy profiles decay into the bulk with decay length 2 ln(3).
discrepancy.independent_result: The exact supplemental factor 3^{-b}, with two physical sites per block, gives decay length 2/ln(3).
discrepancy.paper_source_ref: Main text paragraph immediately following Main Figure 1.
discrepancy.observed_gap: 2 ln(3)-2/ln(3)=0.37674612408254493 physical sites (20.694896% relative to the exact value); the printed law has maximum absolute error 0.0690946077 over b=1..8, versus 1.39e-17 for 2/ln(3).
discrepancy.uncertainty_or_tolerance_basis: This is an exact transfer-matrix exponent, not a fitted quantity. Numerical tolerance is 2e-12 from the independent direct-MPS comparison; the analytic ratio has zero statistical uncertainty.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The Gamma_12/Gamma_21 curves and integrated energies +/-sqrt(2) are reproduced, but the same shared decay-length sentence is quantitatively false for this panel as well: its exact edge terms are proportional to 3^{-b}, giving 2/ln(3), not 2 ln(3).

independent_checks.claim: Each left or right edge term in the printed finite-L Gamma_12/Gamma_21 formula is proportional to 3^{-b}; conversion from block index to physical-site distance gives xi=2/ln(3).

Far from the opposite edge, the exact finite-L denominator tends to one and adjacent two-site blocks retain the exact 1/3 ratio; the L=50 frozen profiles also sum to +/-sqrt(2), excluding a normalization or edge-superposition explanation.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: Opposite edge signs or the nonzero total energy in Gamma_12/Gamma_21 change the bulk exponential from 3^{-b} to the printed 2 ln(3) length.
falsification_attempts.method: Take the one-edge thermodynamic limit separately for both terminations and verify the frozen integrated energies and direct-MPS agreement.

discrepancy.paper_claim: The exact OBC edge-energy profiles in Main Figure 1 decay with length 2 ln(3).
discrepancy.independent_result: Both Gamma_12 and Gamma_21 edge terms have exact physical-site decay length 2/ln(3), independently of their signs and total energies.
discrepancy.paper_source_ref: Main text paragraph immediately following Main Figure 1.
discrepancy.observed_gap: The printed length exceeds the exact length by 0.37674612408254493 sites and predicts an adjacent-block ratio 0.4024279410 instead of exactly 1/3.
discrepancy.uncertainty_or_tolerance_basis: The exponent follows algebraically from a closed form. Direct MPS and formula agree below 2e-12 and integrated energies agree with +/-sqrt(2) to roundoff.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: An independent constrained-bitstring count, inversion-sector decomposition, spectral normalization, and direct Gamma eigenvalue check support the L=18 OBC tower and exact +/-sqrt(2) markers.

independent_checks.claim: Independent legal-bitstring enumeration gives 6765 OBC states, split into inversion dimensions 3410 and 3355; the two Gamma markers occur at +/-sqrt(2) with reported residuals below 1e-12.
The even and odd Z2 overlap distributions each sum to one within 2.3e-14, and both sector spectra obey particle-hole reflection within diagonalization precision.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The starred Gamma points could be artifacts of an incomplete symmetry sector or an arbitrary zero-energy eigenbasis.
falsification_attempts.method: Check that the two inversion dimensions exhaust the full constrained Hilbert space and test H Gamma=+/-sqrt(2) Gamma directly rather than selecting an ED eigenvector.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: All thirteen Xi_n overlap distributions are normalized in their stated sectors, the particle-hole reflected spectra agree, and an independent consecutive-scar mapping reproduces the printed sequence. The apparent Xi_12/Xi_13 mismatch is a rejected global-maximum matching defect, not a paper discrepancy.

independent_checks.claim: Every Xi_1..Xi_13 squared-overlap distribution sums to one within 3.0e-14 in the required K/I sector, and the two spectra reflect under E to -E within 3.6e-14.

Strictly descending consecutive-scar matching yields the printed 63%,78%,89%,92%,92%,90%,86%,79%,72%,62%,50%,32%,9% sequence within 0.015; high-particle states are allowed to split over multiple scars.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The paper's 32% and 9% Xi_12/Xi_13 labels disagree with the generated global maxima 48.9% and 54.8%.
falsification_attempts.method: Compare global maxima with the paper-defined consecutive primary-scar target rather than treating any nearby weaker scar as interchangeable.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The printed H+ recursion independently yields exactly 27 FSA states at L=26. Dominant overlaps, particle-hole reflection, and the basis-invariant 87.224% central zero-subspace weight support Supplement Figure S1.

independent_checks.claim: Hamming distance from Z2 increases by one under every allowed H+ action, reaches the shifted Z2 state after L steps, and therefore constructs L+1=27 normalized FSA basis states.

Particle-hole partners have matching overlaps to 1e-12; summing the central FSA state's weight over the full degenerate E=0 subspace gives 0.8722412664, matching the printed 87% independently of the diagonalizer's basis.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The central 87% annotation is an arbitrary eigenvector-overlap artifact inside the exponentially degenerate zero-energy space.
falsification_attempts.method: Replace the individual eigenvector overlap by the invariant projector weight summed over every |E|<1e-10 vector and compare under particle-hole reflection.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The four displayed peak overlaps are numerically reproduced, but the printed bond-dimension-3 states are not exact eigenstates of the inversion sectors asserted in the supplement and legend. This is visible both algebraically in the printed N matrices and as missing norm in the frozen expected-sector overlaps; it is not caused by rendering or stochastic uncertainty.

independent_checks.claim: The supplement requires Y_I (N_I)^s Y_I^{-1}=N^s with Y_I=diag(-1,-1,1). For the printed N^{00}_{23}=N^{00}_{32}=2 sqrt(2) nu5 this equality requires nu5=0, but the printed nu5=-0.00128607 gives a matrix residual 0.0072751105.

At L=26 the expected-sector overlap weights are 0.9999988416 for Upsilon_1 and 0.9998174635 for tilde-Upsilon_1 rather than one; direct source-equation contraction gives inversion residual norms 0.00215255 and 0.02702121.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The printed bond-dimension-3 SMA matrices generate states wholly inside the K=0,I=1 or K=pi,I=-1 sectors stated by Supplement Figure S2.
falsification_attempts.method: Apply inversion directly to independently contracted source-equation states and, separately, sum every frozen squared overlap in the claimed sector.

discrepancy.paper_claim: The printed Upsilon_1 and tilde-Upsilon_1 bond-dimension-3 ansatzes have exact inversion quantum numbers and belong to the red K=0,I=1 or blue K=pi,I=-1 sectors in Supplement Figure S2.
discrepancy.independent_result: The printed matrices violate the stated inversion gauge relation and the resulting L=26 states retain measurable norm outside the claimed inversion sectors.
discrepancy.paper_source_ref: Supplement Sec. IX.C paragraph defining the inversion constraint and the caption of Figure S2.
discrepancy.observed_gap: Gauge-matrix residual 0.0072751105; state inversion residual norms 0.00215255 and 0.02702121; expected-sector norm deficits 1.15836e-6 and 1.82536e-4.
discrepancy.uncertainty_or_tolerance_basis: An exact symmetry eigenstate should have residual and sector-weight deficit at floating-point roundoff (about 1e-12 or smaller here). The printed nonzero nu5 is seven-significant-digit input, so ordinary parameter rounding cannot turn it into the analytically required zero.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The overlap peaks and qualitative fidelity improvement are reproduced, but the shared printed bond-dimension-3 N matrices do not give the exact inversion quantum numbers asserted for every Upsilon_n MMA state. The frozen data omit 4.85e-8 to 1.40e-6 of state norm from the plotted sector, confirming the analytic violation.

independent_checks.claim: The exact inversion-gauge condition used to assert I=(-1)^{Lb+n} fails for the printed shared N matrices because their nonzero nu5 terms change sign under Y_I transpose conjugation.

Summing each Upsilon_1..Upsilon_13 overlap distribution in its declared sector gives 0.9999985975 to 0.9999999515 rather than one; the deficits persist across particle number and exceed the 1e-12 exact-symmetry tolerance.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: Every printed bond-dimension-3 MMA Upsilon_n state lies exactly in the single K/I sector assigned in Supplement Figure S3.
falsification_attempts.method: Use the analytic N-matrix inversion condition and independently sum the complete frozen spectral weight in the claimed sector for n=1..13.

discrepancy.paper_claim: The bond-dimension-3 MMA wavefunctions have exact symmetry quantum numbers T_x=I=(-1)^{Lb+n} and are fully represented by the plotted sectors.
discrepancy.independent_result: Translation projection is exact, but inversion is not: the source N matrices violate their own gauge condition and every frozen Upsilon_n series has nonzero norm outside the asserted inversion sector.
discrepancy.paper_source_ref: Supplement Sec. IX.C paragraph immediately before Figure S3 and the Figure S3 construction using the same N matrices.
discrepancy.observed_gap: Expected-sector norm deficits range from 4.8486e-8 to 1.4025e-6 at L=26; the underlying local inversion-gauge residual is 0.0072751105.
discrepancy.uncertainty_or_tolerance_basis: The claim is an exact discrete symmetry, so the relevant tolerance is numerical roundoff, conservatively 1e-12. All deficits exceed it by at least four orders of magnitude and share the same analytic source.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: An independent direct contraction from the printed B/C/M matrices reproduces the L=16 exact-vacuum, SMA, and MMA entropies to 3e-16. All six paper sizes, ED scar energies, normalization checks, and the paper's explicit finite-size caveat are internally consistent.

independent_checks.claim: A direct full-basis contraction and Schmidt SVD at L=16 gives (1.7725548044462565, 1.622577877169301, 1.5296742700128165) for Xi_0,Xi_1,Xi_2, matching the frozen CSV to at most 3e-16 without importing the reproducer implementation.
The exact-vacuum entropy rises from 1.77255 to 2.04336 over L=16..26 toward the analytic thermodynamic value about 2.254, while selected ED energies remain near -1.34 and -2.67 as specified.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The apparent straight trends in log(L) were presented as proof of asymptotic logarithmic entanglement for the scar or trial states.
falsification_attempts.method: Compare the six-point series with the supplement's stated asymptotic claims and its finite-size qualification.

target_reviews.assessment_reason: The complete 13-state generalized Ritz problem yields normalized states, strictly ordered Ritz energies inside the exact spectral bounds, the printed overlap sequence, and the stated improvement concentrated toward the ground-state side.

independent_checks.claim: For all 13 rediagonalized states, summed plus/minus spectral weight equals one within 4.6e-13; Ritz energies lie between -14.2781 and -1.31467, inside the exact L=26 spectral range.
The maximum overlaps reproduce 62%,81%,86%,92%,93%,94%,96%,96%,96%,94%,90%,78%,63% within the frozen 0.015 tolerance and alternate cleanly between the two symmetry sectors.

falsification_attempts.hypothesis: The apparent overlap improvement is caused by a singular Gram matrix or unnormalized generalized eigenvectors rather than by the 13-dimensional variational subspace.
falsification_attempts.method: Check all Ritz energies and complete spectral norms, and verify every one of the 13 expected states is present with a unique ordered eigenvalue.

findings.claim: The main-text decay length 2 ln(3) is algebraically inconsistent with the exact 3^{-b} edge profile; the physical-site decay length is 2/ln(3).
reproduction_steps: Read the exact local-energy formula in Supplemental Sec. VI and isolate either 3^{-b} edge term.
Set j approximately 2b and solve 3^{-b}=exp(-j/xi), obtaining xi=2/ln(3).
Compare the exact adjacent-block ratio 1/3 with 0.4024279410 predicted by xi=2 ln(3), then verify the frozen T001 profile and direct-MPS crosscheck.

findings.claim: The same printed decay length is false for the nonzero-energy Gamma_12/Gamma_21 profiles; edge signs and total energy do not change the exact exponent.
reproduction_steps: Insert alpha,beta=(1,2) and (2,1) into the supplemental finite-L formula.
Take the one-edge thermodynamic limit and derive the 1/3 ratio per two physical sites.
Confirm the L=50 profiles integrate to +/-sqrt(2) while retaining xi=2/ln(3).

findings.claim: The printed bond-dimension-3 SMA matrices do not produce the exact inversion sectors asserted in Supplement Figure S2, although the plotted peak overlaps remain numerically close.
reproduction_steps: Apply Y_I=diag(-1,-1,1) to the transposed printed N matrices and inspect the (2,3) element of N^{00}.
Observe that equality requires nu5=0 but the paper prints nu5=-0.00128607, giving residual 0.0072751105.
Sum the frozen T006 overlap arrays in the claimed sectors and compare with unity; independently contract the printed states and apply inversion.

findings.claim: The bond-dimension-3 MMA family inherits the same inversion defect, so the exact I=(-1)^{Lb+n} statement and single-sector representation are not strictly correct for Supplement Figure S3.
reproduction_steps: Use the same printed N matrices in the Upsilon_n definition and apply the stated inversion-gauge relation.
For each frozen overlap_upsilon_n array, sum all spectral weights in the claimed sector.
Compare the 4.85e-8 to 1.40e-6 deficits with the 1e-12 exact-symmetry tolerance and the analytic nonzero gauge residual.
